notes: A 4-way convertible hood in 30 and 36 in. widths, ducted through 7 in. round or 3-1/4 by 10 in. duct or run non-ducted with a ductless filter. The aluminum filter (R610045) is for ducted use only, and the blower motor and blade come as one service assembly, R730088.

gaps: Light conflict: the current guide 99043005L says an LED bulb up to 15 W; spec sheet 99042442G says 15 W LED in its features but 20 W LED max in its typical specification.
The earlier guide 99043005G, the AJ Madison sheet 99042442E and the 433004 product page say 75 W (incandescent). The light entry follows the current guide.
The 115 V, 60 Hz, 1.8 A rating on the spec sheets is for the hood, so v and a are not put on the motor; no motor-only rating was found.
The host labels the manual BROAN 43004, but the maker's documents say 43000 series and Broan-NuTone's page for model 433004 (30 in., stainless) links them, so the record covers the series.
The guide mentions a charcoal pad on the supplied filter but does not say which listed part holds charcoal, so the carbon entry gives the parts and wording as listed.
Both printings of the guide (99043005G and 99043005L) list the same part numbers.
method: Broan-NuTone 43000 series installation guide on broan-nutone.com (Installation_Guide_43000.pdf, form 99043005L): PDF page 2 (filters in the box, non-ducted filter) and page 4 (installation steps, use and care, replacement parts list, rendered and columns checked).
Broan-NuTone 43000 series range hood spec sheet on broan-nutone.com (doc code 99042442G), read as text.
Earlier printing of the guide (form 99043005G) hosted by Appliance Factory Parts (137484-2.pdf): PDF page 5, rendered; used for the 75 W wording.
Broan 43000 series spec sheet, AJ Madison copy (doc code 99042442E), read as text, for the 75 W incandescent wording.
Broan-NuTone product page for model 433004 (discontinued), which links the spec sheet and installation guide above.
Sears PartsDirect and HD Supply part pages returned HTTP 403 to the researcher and were not used.

comps.spec: Motor/blade assembly, Broan part R730088 (parts list key 3). The guide says the fan motor has lifetime sealed bearings that never need oiling in normal use.
Blower blade, supplied as part of the motor/blade assembly R730088 (parts list key 3).
Washable aluminum filter with a built-in light lens, Broan R610045 (parts list key 4), for ducted hoods. The guide says it can be cleaned in a dishwasher.

Ductless-use parts, bought separately: Filter - Ductless R610050 (the guide also names BP57 as the non-ducted filter) and Filter Pads - Ductless R610051. The guide also mentions a charcoal pad on the supplied filter, removed for vented use, and a combination filter to replace when saturated.
Lampholder R566088 (parts list key 5). The current guide says to use an LED bulb, A19, E26 base, 15 W maximum.
Hood body in powder-coat white, black or biscuit, or made of stainless steel; all exposed edges hemmed; 30 and 36 in. widths.
Fan switch (key 1) and light switch (key 2). Parts 97016970 black, 97016971 white, 97016972 almond, 97016973 biscuit; each switch part is listed as including the other switch.
